author: kesudh
method: Rust warm-start large-neighborhood search: exact per-net SPT reroute with equal-delay tie exploration, group rip-up with negotiated-congestion rounds (PathFinder-style history/present costs), bounded threshold acceptance; every accepted state re-verified by the repository checker.

upstream_credit.author: Tazeem Mahashin
upstream_credit.note: Warm starts are PR#3's routes at head c2d9d9f, the version merged into main. Where a route is carried unchanged the route_sha256 equals the pr3_sha256 and the credit is his.

selection: Lowest checker-recomputed delay per case among PR#3's route, this engine's refinements, and our earlier published route; a route is labelled verbatim only when byte-identical.
runtime: Per-case wall seconds of the incremental refinement only; excludes warm-start generation. Omitted where no case in the tier was refined by this engine.
